text: A股三大指数集体翻绿，科创50指数跌超1%，医药医疗、风电设备、工程机械、半导体等方向跌幅居前，沪深京三市下跌个股超2500只
text_en: All three major A-share indices turn red; STAR 50 drops over 1%; pharma/healthcare, wind power equipment, construction machinery, semiconductors lead declines; over 2,500 stocks fall across Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets
